blocks.text: Links use double brackets. Each form below is shown as typed, then as the live link it produces.

- `[[spinning-cube]]` gives [[spinning-cube]]
- `[[spinning-cube|the 3D cube page]]` gives [[spinning-cube|the 3D cube page]]
- `[[projects/makuraba]]` opens a whole group: [[projects/makuraba]]
- `[[library]]` opens a menu section: [[library]]
- `[GitHub Pages docs](https://docs.github.com/pages)` is a normal web link: [GitHub Pages docs](https://docs.github.com/pages)

blocks.note: A card can point at a page, a group path, or a web address

blocks.text: The editor tells you when you save, and the words stay as plain text, so nothing silently points nowhere. Renaming a page's title is always safe: its file name and id stay the same, so links keep working.
